turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you get that software update for my laptop installed? The fan was acting up again yesterday.
Yes, Alan. The update completed successfully at 2 AM. The fan noise has dropped significantly since then.
Nice. Also, I was reading up on that Exoplanet Detection article I sent you. It’s wild how hard it is to find these things.
It really is. The transit method requires very precise alignment and multiple passes to confirm.

Right. But here's the thing I keep coming back to: The difficulty in detecting Earth-like planets does not necessarily imply that such planets are rare. Just because we can't see them well doesn't mean they aren't there.
That is a valid point. Detection bias often confuses observation limits with actual prevalence.
Exactly. Anyway, did you order that new coffee grinder yet? The old one is making a weird grinding noise.
I placed the order yesterday. It should arrive by Thursday.
